steps.title: Request Authorization
steps.description: Authorize a user by redirecting them to the Pipedrive OAuth authorization page using GET https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/authorize?client_id=b4d083d9216986345b32&state=148aHxbdd92&redirect_uri=https://awesomeapp.com/oauth/callback. This step is necessary to implement only when you allow app installation outside of the Marketplace.
steps.expectedOutcome: The customer's web browser makes a request to the OAuth server's /authorize endpoint.

evidence.qualification: Directly supported by the instructions and example URL for requesting authorization when allowing app installation outside of the Marketplace.

steps.title: Handle Callback and Receive Authorization Code
steps.description: Receive the authorization code at the registered redirect_uri callback URL if it matches with the value you entered in the registration form when a user approves the app install.
steps.expectedOutcome: The authorization code is sent to that callback URL.

evidence.qualification: Directly supported by the callback explanation regarding matching redirect_uri and receiving the authorization code.

steps.title: Exchange Authorization Code for Tokens
steps.description: Execute a POST request to https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/token with grant_type authorization_code, code, and redirect_uri parameters.
steps.expectedOutcome: Receive a response containing access and refresh tokens.

evidence.qualification: Directly supported by the token request endpoint and required body parameters for grant_type, code, and redirect_uri.

steps.title: Client Authentication and Request Encoding
steps.description: Authenticate the token request via HTTP Basic Auth with the values of the client_id and the client_secret, and set the content-type for the request to application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
steps.expectedOutcome: The request is successfully authenticated and encoded for token exchange.

evidence.qualification: Directly supported by the instructions requiring HTTP Basic Auth with client_id and client_secret and application/x-www-form-urlencoded content-type.

gaps.text: Exact structure and full list of fields in the JSON token response body besides access_token are not fully detailed in the provided excerpts.

evidence.qualification: The provided context cuts off right after introducing access_token, lacking the full response schema.
